headline: Across media, gaming, publishing and education firms are balancing AI pushes with cost pressures.
summary: Media firms report solid revenue growth but are tightening IT spend amid layoffs. Gaming operators are expanding digital platforms while some see widening losses. Publishing shows mixed results with AI initiatives offset by weak performance at Scholastic. Education players are investing in AI and quantum research, with overall revenue growth.

industries.summary: Disney posted 7% revenue growth and strong operating margin. Warner Bros Discovery/Skydance raised its EBITDA outlook despite a revenue decline. Versant reaffirmed guidance with modest growth. Cost‑cutting and AI projects dominate the agenda.

leaders.why: Revenue of $25,248 m and 22% operating margin

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Patents for real‑time AI characters and AI‑driven data platforms are being filed.

themes.title: Cost‑cutting
themes.detail: Layoffs and restructuring aim for up to 20% staff reductions.

industries.it_note: IT teams should focus on supporting AI pilots while managing reduced budgets and staff.

industries.summary: Caesars posted record revenue but widened its net loss. Bally’s saw 20% revenue growth and heavy financing for new sites. Light & Wonder launched a cashless payment system. Digital rebuilds are a common thread.

leaders.why: Revenue $2,940 m, highest in the sector

laggards.why: Negative operating margin of -4.3% despite growth

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: New casino and sportsbook platforms are being launched and expanded.

themes.title: Financing for tech infrastructure
themes.detail: Bally’s secured $560 m and $400 m to build new casino technology.

industries.it_note: Technology teams should prioritize rapid rollout of digital casino platforms and cashless payment solutions.

industries.summary: Wolters Kluwer expanded AI tools across tax and legal products. Scholastic missed revenue and posted a large operating loss. Pearson delivered strong revenue growth and narrowed profit guidance. AI development is a shared focus.

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: AI‑driven tax prep, legal tools and AI tutors are being launched.

themes.title: Cost restructuring
themes.detail: Pearson reshaped four units and changed management.

industries.it_note: IT should enable AI integration across content creation and delivery platforms.

industries.summary: Pearson posted revenue acceleration and AI‑enhanced tutoring. NYU secured multiple $30 m+ investments for quantum and AI research. SLU added AI to its partnership and outsourced custodial services. Overall, institutions are expanding tech spend.

themes.title: AI research and applications
themes.detail: Universities and providers are launching AI tutors, archaeological reconstruction tools, and quantum labs.
